INTRODUCTION TO CAI
To view new information press the Enter key on your keyboard or select the Next arrow using the mouse.
To view previous information press the Left Arrow key on your keyboard or select the Back arrow using the mouse.
To view available function keys press F1.
*Note: The Left Arrow key is available in this lesson only.
OBJECTIVES
1. Computer Communication
* Learn how the mouse is used in a CAI lesson.
* Learn how the keyboard is used in a CAI lesson.
2. Types of Pages
* Identify lesson page types.
* Become familiar with lesson structure.
EQUIPMENT REQUIRED
1. IBM PC Compatible Computer
INTRODUCTION
Congratulations on your decision to use Computer Assisted Instruction (CAI). CAI is like having your own private teacher.
The lessons are interesting and learning is exciting with CAI.
Let's begin the lesson on INTRODUCTION TO CAI.
LESSON MENU
Use your mouse to select one of the items from the menu.
COMPUTER COMMUNICATION
DISCUSSION
The computer is your teacher, and you need to know how to talk to the computer. There are two input devices you can use to communicate with the computer: the keyboard and the mouse.

The mouse is used to navigate through the lesson and make selections from the displayed page. To make a selection with the mouse, move the mouse until the pointer is over an active item and press one of the buttons on the mouse. The pressing action is referred to as "clicking".
Selectable items on pages are identified by cyan buttons or highlighted areas. When the caption of a button is gray the button can not be selected, it is not active (OFF).
* This button is not active. It cannot be selected.
* This button is active. It can be selected.

You move forward by clicking the Next button and backward by selecting the Back button. You ask for assistance by selecting the help button. Definitions are provided when you select cyan words from the main body of text.
The mouse is used to make selections from the menus in the lesson. You have already seen an example of this, you used the mouse to select options from the menus to get this far.
The mouse is also used to answer questions. On the following page, answer the question by placing the pointer over the correct answer and clicking.
Which of the following squares is WHITE? Select the answer with your mouse.
You selected the color WHITE. If you did not see feedback for an incorrect answer go back to the question and select a wrong answer.
